blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Write-time re-review on 2026-07-31 of the sole tracked Base deployment 0xc0d3700000987c99b3c9009069e4f8413fd22330. Sourcify's exact-match ABI exposes ERC-20 transfer/transferFrom, facilitator mint/burn, owner/guardian administration, and pauseBridge/unpauseBridge/lzPause, but no isBlacklisted, blacklist, freeze, seize, pause(), or paused() surface. At Base block 49332025 (timestamp 2026-07-30T23:16:33Z), live eth_call returned owner=0xc0D3700924301AC384E5Eae3272E08220752DE3D, guardian=0x0D1d0f89cb988678B37FD5b5c6C1A5bBdc55f8ba, lzPause=false, and totalSupply=6,150,000e18; paused() reverted. The deployed ABI/bytecode exposes pauseBridge (0x7dd0480f) and lzPause (0x3771e259) while the blacklist/freeze selectors isBlacklisted (0xfe575a87), blacklist (0xf9f92be4), pause (0x8456cb59), and paused (0x5c975abb) are absent. Cod3x's current technical overview describes facilitator credit mint/burn under protocol limits, not holder freeze. Bridge pause is confined to LayerZero OFT paths, not ordinary ERC-20 transfers. Conclusion: no direct holder freeze/blacklist; canBeBlacklisted=false.
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: Facilitator strategies may hold freezable third-party stablecoins or crypto collateral, which can impair redemption value, but those issuers have no holder-level freeze path on the cdxUSD ERC-20 itself. That exposure remains reserve/dependency risk, not cdxUSD token blacklistability.

oracleRisk.summary: cdxUSD supply is created through governance-limited Facilitator credit buckets rather than user CDPs whose collateral health is continuously priced for liquidation.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: Cod3x documents cdxUSD as a GHO-style system in which approved Facilitators receive bounded lines of credit and mint or burn under protocol limits. The token layer does not expose borrower-owned collateral positions, per-collateral health factors, or permissionless liquidation branches; any strategy risk belongs to the individual Facilitator rather than a shared cdxUSD liquidation engine.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: cdxUSD is an omnichain stablecoin moved cross-chain as a LayerZero OFT; the exact captured supply sits on Base, where the OFT contract is the mint/burn authority for the representation.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20)
bridgeRouteRisk.sourceFreeRationale: The tracked cdxUSD contract set has one Base deployment, and reviewed Cod3x material describes mint/burn facilitators rather than a cross-chain token route.

routes.reviewNote: Controller verified on-chain 2026-07-20: endpoint() of the Cod3x USD token on Base returns the LayerZero EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c, so this deployment is the Cod3x OFT and the OFT contract itself is the mint/burn authority for the representation (totalSupply 6,150,000 cdxUSD, matching the exact captured supply; OFT owner/delegate 0xc0d3700924301ac384e5eae3272e08220752de3d).
